workflows.title: Connect and validate a custom provider
workflows.complete_when: provider/model pair and supported normalized tuning are captured only after acknowledgement (p.183).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Fake "Connected" from config save; fake probe success; fake capability authority from a model marketing name; fake effective state from a green toast; secret values in project files.

workflows.title: Set up a local model without false locality
workflows.complete_when: a ready local route is explicit and observed usage remains unavailable until a durable read exists (p.183).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: "Local" inferred from a URL on the laptop; observed allocation fabricated from the model name; a private-LAN route shown as enabled; semantic index claimed without an embedder.

workflows.title: Tune a model and change it mid-session
workflows.complete_when: each executed call records actual route and effective parameters, separately from current draft preference (p.183).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Showing the picker's model as the executed model; rewriting an in-flight call; treating a reasoning enum as a writable API; silently dropping an unsupported parameter.

workflows.title: Move from Ask to Plan to Code
workflows.complete_when: a new Code admission binds the approved plan version and execution envelope (p.183).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Calling a plain prompt "read-only"; approving a plan and silently broadening authority; treating a preset label as a permission grant.

workflows.title: Assemble context and resolve overflow
workflows.complete_when: the admitted request has a versioned source manifest and valid capacity calculation (p.184).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: A filename or tab title shown as attached content; a composed context number labelled measured; silent omission of a failed attachment; hidden truncation of criteria.

workflows.title: Compact and inspect continuity
workflows.complete_when: required contract, candidate identity and unresolved obligations remain reachable and active (p.184).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: A compacted transcript view shown as runtime context reduction; a 1% summary accepted as success; deletion implied by compaction; measured reduction fabricated from an estimate.

workflows.title: Approve once or create a narrow rule
workflows.complete_when: one exact approval resolves once; a persisted rule has named scope, version and expiry (p.184).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Persisting Allow once automatically; a green "Allowed" toast without dispatch; a rule shown active without a policy store; duplicate reply generating a second effect.

workflows.title: Add MCP with trust and recover auth
workflows.complete_when: only discovered, healthy, enabled and authorized tools are offered to the correct task (p.184).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Config save shown as Connected; Ready without handshake; remote/OAuth shown from stdio config; repository content starting a server; disconnect treated as Cancelled.

workflows.title: Install and invoke a skill safely
workflows.complete_when: versioned instructions are attributed and execution still uses effective grants (p.185).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Viewing a package executing setup; installation shown as authorization; hidden skill still invocable; instruction text widening grants.

workflows.title: Author and test a lifecycle hook
workflows.complete_when: a hook run cites exact spec version, event, envelope and bounded audit artifact (p.185).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Partial output after timeout shown as Allow; test run emitting a real production lifecycle event; malformed verdict treated as pass; fail-open hidden.

workflows.title: Delegate and steer a bounded child
workflows.complete_when: shared budget and ownership hold; a child saying done does not establish parent verification (p.185).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Child "done" shown as parent verified; unbounded child wallets; stale controls acting on a new generation; steer silently truncated.

workflows.title: Queue, background and interrupt work
workflows.complete_when: each queue item/process/control retains owner, generation and durable result (p.185).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Closed tab shown as cancellation; lost stream shown as idle; stop shown as confirmed remote rollback; queue item silently discarded.

workflows.title: Handle rate limit, cap and unknown spend
workflows.complete_when: the final ledger retains every eligible attempted charge, including failed/cancelled work (p.186).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Guessed reset time; zero for unknown price; cap decrease shown as deleting spend; cancelled work omitted from the eligible numerator.

workflows.title: Review, restore or fork without overwriting edits
workflows.complete_when: a changed candidate invalidates stale proof; historical verified artifacts remain historical (p.186).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Universal undo claimed from hashes; restore silently overwriting user edits; fork shown as file rollback; old proof reused for a new tree.

workflows.title: Finish a change with complete proof
workflows.complete_when: required acceptance, claims, landing equality and requested finish all have explicit matching facts (p.186).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Green finish from chat completion; proof reused across candidate identities; PR created without SCM; empty required set treated as success.

workflows.title: Recover a remote host or runtime change
workflows.complete_when: all callbacks and controls are fenced to the new binding; unknown effects stay visible (p.186).
workflows.forbidden_fake_states: Old handle controlling a new host; local URL shown as daemon loopback; copied credentials; replaying an old effectful request on a new host.
